L2: # Immunotherapy
L3: for canine cancer.
L4: 
L5: * * *
L6: 
L7: Intro
L8: 
L9: ### In partnership with Ardent Animal Health, we are developing a dual-action immunotherapy for canine osteosarcoma.
L10: 
L11: ### Osteosarcoma accounts for 85% of bone tumors in dogs and carries a median survival time of less than one year with standard treatment.
L12: ### By applying validated human cancer science, our dual-action immunotherapy is designed to improve outcomes for one of the most common and lethal cancers in dogs.
L13: 
L14: * * *
L15: 
L16: Program
L17: 
L18: Indication: Canine osteosarcoma
L19: 
L20: Mechanism of action: A dual-action immunotherapy combining an autologous vaccine (K9-ACV) with a novel checkpoint inhibitor (CD200AR-L) to stimulate a robust anti-tumor immune response
L21: Origin: The novel checkpoint inhibitor (CD200AR-L) is based on research from the University of Minnesota, with companion animal rights licensed to Unleash Therapeutics, LLC (via OX2 Therapeutics).
L22: 
L23: Partner: 【1†Ardent Animal Health†ardentanimalhealth.com】 - the dual-action immunotherapy combines our novel checkpoint inhibitor with Ardent’s existing autologous cancer vaccine (K9-ACV), and will be commercialized under the Ardent Animal Health brand.
L24: Status: Clinical - we are conducting a multi-center randomized field efficacy study, sponsored by researchers at the University of Illinois College of Veterinary Medicine. Recruitment is now complete.
L25: 
L26: 【2†Learn more about our clinical trial  >>>†studypages.com】
L27: 
L28: * * *
L29: 
L30: About
L31: 
L32: Unleash Therapeutics, LLC is a single-asset company focused exclusively on bringing this immunotherapy to dogs with osteosarcoma.
L33: The company was founded in 2021 by 【3†Dr. Elizabeth Iorns†www.linkedin.com】 and 【4†Dan Knox†www.linkedin.com】. Elizabeth is a cancer biologist whose French Bulldog, Lily, was diagnosed with a terminal brain tumor in 2020. Her experience with Lily's treatment highlighted the gap between human and veterinary oncology — and became the catalyst for Unleash Therapeutics, LLC.
L34: Elizabeth and Dan are also the co-founders of 【5†Familiar†familiartx.com】, an animal health therapeutics company building a broad pipeline of modern medicines for companion animals. They are longtime collaborators who previously co-founded Science Exchange (YC S11), a global R&D marketplace, and who invest together through a shared angel fund across technology and life sciences.
L35:

L23: # 〖臨床研究〗猫の口腔扁平上皮がんで症例募集中！
L24: 
L25: 2025年8月18日
L26: ## 概要
L27: 
L28: ペットのがん治療には、手術、抗がん剤、放射線治療があります。放射線治療は、腫瘍に直接放射線を当てる方法ですが、腫瘍内が低酸素状態だと効果が下がることがあります。「レブリチン」は2023年に承認された世界初の動物用放射線増感剤で、腫瘍内の酸素を一時的に増やし、放射線治療の効果を高めます。岐阜大学動物病院では、猫の口腔扁平上皮がんに対して、放射線治療とレブリチンの併用による臨床研究を行っています。
L29: 
L30: ## 対象
L31: 
L32: 猫の口腔扁平上皮がん
L33: 
L34: ## 試験内容
L35: 
L36:   * 5日間の放射線治療中にレブリチンを使用
L37:   * 放射線治療後1・3・6か月後に経過確認のため来院の必要あり
L38: 
L39: ## 治療費について
L40: 
L41: 通常の治療費は発生しますが、レブリチンの薬剤費は無料です。
L42:
